footer.notice: For security self-check of authorized assets only

login.title: LightShield Security Self-Check Console
login.lead: Submit authorized targets, track scan status, and read Markdown reports in your browser.
login.heading: Enter dashboard
login.hint: Default credentials: admin / lightshield. Override via environment variables in production.
login.error: Login failed. Please check your username and password.

dashboard.title: Scan panel
dashboard.head_note: Frontend provides basic R2/R4 reminders; final validation is still performed by the API layer.
dashboard.confirm_own: I confirm that I own the target or have obtained explicit authorization
dashboard.status_detail: Enter a single IP or domain name and complete R4 authorization confirmation.
dashboard.empty_hint: After completing your first authorized scan, the last 20 records will appear here.
dashboard.err_target_space: Target address must not contain spaces
dashboard.err_target_url: Enter a domain or IP, without a URL scheme
dashboard.err_target_path: Enter a single IP or domain, without paths, CIDR, or query parameters
dashboard.err_status_timeout: Scan status query timed out. Please refresh the dashboard later.
dashboard.timeout_detail: The scan is still running in the background. Check the history later.
dashboard.err_r4: R4 compliance requirement: please confirm target ownership or authorization scope first.
dashboard.status_submitting_detail: Request sent to the LightShield API.

report.title: Scan report
report.load_fail_body: Unable to load the report. Please return to the dashboard to check the scan status.

harden.title: Hardening recommendations
harden.rec_note: Generated based on scan findings and the rule engine, for review before script generation only.
harden.none_body: The current scan did not match any risk items requiring script generation.
harden.confirm_own: I confirm that I own the target and authorize the generation of hardening scripts (R4)
harden.warn_manual: LightShield only generates hardening and rollback scripts; it will not execute commands automatically. Please review scripts before running them manually.
harden.err_r4: R4 compliance requirement: Please confirm target ownership and authorization scope first.
